metadata.title: JODARIS — Engineering ideas into impact.
metadata.description: JODARIS brings together Digital Applications, Research, Innovation, and Systems. Engineering ideas into purposeful technology and meaningful impact.

hero.heading: Engineering ideas into impact.
hero.description: We bring digital applications, research, innovation, and systems together to turn ambitious ideas into purposeful technology.

expertise.heading: Four disciplines. Infinite possibility.
expertise.intro: The best solutions happen where disciplines connect. We unite thoughtful engineering, meaningful exploration, and a systems mindset to create what comes next.

disciplines.heading: Digital Applications
disciplines.summary: Intuitive experiences. Powerful functionality. Web and mobile applications that make everyday complexity feel simple.

dialog.title: Digital Applications
dialog.label: 01 / MAKE IT REAL
dialog.description: Digital products should feel clear, capable, and easy to use. We connect experience design with thoughtful engineering to bring useful applications to life.

disciplines.heading: Research
disciplines.summary: Good questions lead to better decisions. We explore emerging technologies, test assumptions, and uncover useful possibilities.

dialog.title: Research
dialog.label: 02 / ASK WHAT IF
dialog.description: Research creates the space to question assumptions before committing to a direction. We explore technologies and test possibilities with practical outcomes in mind.
items: Proofs of concept and experimental validation

disciplines.heading: Innovation
disciplines.summary: Fresh thinking, made tangible. We shape ideas into prototypes and new products with a clear purpose and room to grow.

dialog.title: Innovation
dialog.label: 03 / CHALLENGE THE EXPECTED
dialog.description: Innovation is more than a new idea. It is the work of turning a promising possibility into something valuable, testable, and ready to develop further.
items: Rapid prototypes and minimum viable products
New digital services and ways of working

disciplines.heading: Systems
disciplines.summary: Strong foundations for connected organizations. Integrated systems and workflows designed to work together, not in isolation.

dialog.title: Systems
dialog.label: 04 / CONNECT THE WHOLE
dialog.description: A system is only as useful as the connections within it. We think across platforms, data, and workflows to create coherent foundations for digital operations.
items: Cloud-ready foundations and connected data flows

about.heading: Technology is the tool. Moving people and possibilities forward is the point.
about.copy: JODARIS is built around a simple belief: progress comes from connecting curiosity with the craft of building. We look beyond individual products to consider the people, ideas, and systems around them.

approach.heading: Not just built. Thought through.
approach.intro: A clear direction. A considered process. We move from understanding the challenge to building something that matters—and keep learning along the way.

steps.heading: Start with the right questions.
steps.description: Understand the people, the challenge, and the opportunity. We listen closely, investigate the context, and explore what would make a meaningful difference.

steps.heading: Give ambition a clear direction.
steps.description: Translate what we learn into a practical plan. Define the experience, the architecture, and the priorities—so every decision serves the purpose behind the work.

steps.heading: Make the idea work in the real world.
steps.description: Prototype, develop, and refine in purposeful steps. Bring design and engineering together, test what matters, and turn the blueprint into a usable solution.

steps.heading: Launch is a beginning, not an ending.
steps.description: Learn from real use. Gather feedback, understand what can work better, and refine the solution as needs and opportunities change.

contact.heading: What’s your next big idea?
contact.dialog_heading: Tell us what’s on your mind.
contact.dialog_intro: A few details are all we need to start a useful conversation.
contact.delivery: User-reviewed mailto draft; no backend submission
